==Description==
'''The Hatch Event''' was a Roblox-sponsored limited event where the players would look for an egg hidden in the lobby. Tower Defense Simulator was one of the multiple [[File:TheHatchEnergy.png|20px|link=]] {{Color|Pirate|Energy Biome}} games.

'''The Hatch Event''' was not immediately accessible when joining the game, as it had specific requirements for its activation.

==Activation==
[[File:EnergyBiome.png|125px|thumb|Energy biome on map]]
'''The Hatch Event''' could not be activated by entering Tower Defense Simulator normally. Instead, the player had to enter {{RLinkG|98209635344835|The Hatch}} game on Roblox, then find the [[File:TheHatchEnergy.png|20px|link=]] {{Color|Pirate|Energy Biome}} in the Crackling Glen. It could be found to the left of the Crackling Glen's spawn area. Once entering the portal, the player had to pick Tower Defense Simulator.

Once done, the player would be able to tell that '''The Hatch Event''' has been activated by the presence of a large cracked egg next to the Events gate. Walking up to this egg would have a pop-up message appear for the event.

==Egg Locations==
After activating '''The Hatch Event''', one of the ten [[File:TheHatchEnergy.png|20px|link=]] {{Color|Pirate|Energy}} eggs would appear in the lobby. There were seven possible spots for them. If the player left and rejoined using the same activation method, the location of the egg would change, but the egg collected would not.

Collecting the egg granted nothing other than progress in '''The Hatch Event''' and a badge in Tower Defense Simulator.

==Trivia==
*When selecting Tower Defense Simulator while in The Hatch hub, the game title mentions the {{Color|EventMission|Ducky}} [[DJ Booth]]. This was likely the title of the game when Paradoxum Games submitted the game to be part of the event.
